newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel economic leaders to meet on budget Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Israel economic leaders to meet on budget Tuesday.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel and Finance Minister Yaacov Neeman will meet on Tuesday to discuss the 1997 and 1998 budgets, the Treasury said on Monday.
The meeting will take place in Jerusalem at 1200 (0900 GMT). It was not known whether any decisions would be reached at the meeting.

Both Frenkel and Netanyahu favour an immediate cut of 600 million shekels in the 1997 budget. But Treasury budget officials favour waiting and combining a cut needed in 1997 with a reduction in the 1998 budget, Treasury sources said.
Neeman has not yet stated his position on the matter.
